usedFor: Shopify holds orders and checkouts, and AWeber receives the shopper through “Add Subscriber To List” after an “Abandoned Checkout”.

bestTemplate.name: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify, then “Add Subscriber To List” in AWeber
bestTemplate.why: A shopper who left at checkout joins a list, ready for a follow-up.

watchOut: “Abandoned Checkout” is polling, so the subscriber is added after a scheduled check.
